description: This file contains utility functions for verifying the status of Matrix devices, based on their verification status object. It provides functions to check if a device is locally verified, owner verified, or verified in the current client context.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified( isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified
methods.description: Checks if the device's localVerified property is true, indicating local verification.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified( isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Determines if the device is verified via cross-signing or signed by the owner.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient( isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient
methods.description: Checks if the device is verified in the current client, either by method call or via local or owner verification checks.
